title: The Mystery Spot
specs: Beautiful hiking trail with eucalyptus tree views
Tours are on a 55 degree slope and include stairs and uneven surfaces, difficult for persons with limited physical abilities
Groups up to 25 tickets per tour; school, church, YMCA, youth groups welcome
School groups of 15+ weekdays eligible for discounted rate $9 per student plus two free chaperones per 20 students
includes: Cold drinks and snack bar onsite for school groups
Onsite bathrooms, picnic area with tables and benches
blurb: Guests take a fully guided 45-minute tour of the Mystery Spot, experiencing its gravitational phenomenon. There is also a small 15-minute hiking trail through the redwoods with a view through eucalyptus trees. The site includes a gift store, picnic area, and nature trail.
extraNote: Arrive 30 minutes prior to tour time or you will miss your tour · Refunds available if tour not enjoyed due to physical limitations; must complete refund request form · No extra ticket fees; parking fee $5 payable on arrival · Alcoholic beverages not allowed on property · Window on the right hand side of the ticket shack marked "Internet Reservations" for guests with advance tickets.
